purpose: Attribute same-cycle multi-target probe transport failures without rewriting, suppressing or weakening raw Shine Defence health evidence.
qualification: Probe results are grouped by scheduled request minute and deduplicated to the latest result per target in that cycle.
A correlated transport event requires at least the minimum number of affected targets.
At least the configured fraction of targets in the cycle must have transport failures.
A transport failure is a timeout or a missing HTTP status with an error message.
The same qualifying cycle must contain no non-transport contract failures.
Recovery requires a later cycle with at least as many observed targets and every observed result passing its contract.
invariants: This layer is attribution-only and never changes defence_health_probe_results, defence_health_observations, estate incidents or admission state.
The raw estate state remains authoritative and is returned unchanged alongside the attribution.
A recovered correlated event may remain visible while the existing rolling health window still retains its failed samples.
No automatic probe retry, app restart, incident suppression or evidence deletion is authorised.
Browser roles receive no EXECUTE grant.
